facts.fact: 他踱步打量客厅：无骨灰沙发（他睡了几夜）、雪人毯、Pumpkin 玻璃围栏——墙上没有照片，只有一张镇广场黑白照
facts.anchor: no pictures around the room except for a framed black-and-white photograph

facts.fact: 闪回她宿舍：Kaylee 那面墙全是家人、朋友、抱着猫狗的照片——Ansel 抽走了她生活里的颜色，他想还给她
facts.anchor: covered with photographs of her family, friends

facts.fact: 她出房门（湿发、帽衫、赤脚）：不再跑了
她的条件：抓人时我作证——still scared out of my mind，但 Elasia deserves justice
facts.anchor: When you arrest them, I’ll testify.

facts.fact: 她主动澄清：上过床与决定作证是两件事
facts.anchor: having sex with you was completely separate

facts.fact: 她拒绝他的道歉——道歉等于说他们做错了；我是同意的成年人，享受了数次强烈高潮——你是单身吧？
条件：圣诞节后才走（已报名做舞会饼干）；无论上级来催都要 promise 等她
facts.anchor: I have some conditions about my testimony.

facts.fact: 她的 bucket list：Go ice-skating／do something that matters／cut down my own Christmas tree／learn to drive a snowmobile／master the two-step／看山顶风景（恐高）
他读到第 19 项笑出来——折好纸条：现在就可以划掉一项
facts.anchor: I think we can check one off your list right now.
